tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// gza'i nad rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i gzungs bzhugs so//

༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ badzra hri pa sha sha gu ya/ bod skad du/ gza'i nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i gzungs/ rdo rje mi bskyod pa la phyag 'tshal lo// 'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ dpal phyag na rdo rje bsil ba'i tshal du bzhugs so// de'i tshe gza' dang rgyu skar dbang du sdud pa'i gzungs 'di gsungs so// tadya thā/ oṃ badzra pā ṇi hūṃ/ ha sa ha sa/ dha ra dha ra swā hā/ de skad ces gsungs pa dang*/ yab srin po dang*/ yum klu mo dang*/ drang srong chen po rā hu la dang*/ srin mo gdong mo bzhi dang*/ rgyu ba'i gza' bdun dang*/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang*/ gegs dang*/ sde brgyad la sogs pa rnams/ phyag na rdo rje'i 'khor du 'dus te gus par byas nas/ rang rang gi gza'i nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i gzungs 'di gsungs so// de ni 'di lta ste/ oṃ badzra yakṣa ghan dhe hu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭa/ yab yag sha nag po thod pa'i phreng ba can gyi nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar gyur cig swā hā/ oṃ badzra na ga rā hu la mu lu mu lu swā hā/ yum haṃ shaṃ sbal mgo khrag mig ma'i nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar gyur cig swā hā/ oṃ badzra pa sha mi ki ri tsu lu tsu lu swā hā/ drang srong gza'i rgyal po rā hu la'i nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar gyur cig swā hā/ oṃ badzra rag mo ma ma swā hā/ srin mo shar gyi stag srin zor ba'i gdong can gyi nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar gyur cig swā hā/ o badzra rag mo mu mu sa hā/ srin mo lho'i dam sri dred mo'i gdong can gyi nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar gyur cig swā hā/ oṃ badzra rag mo me me swā hā/ srin mo nub kyi rgod srin ba glang gdong can gyi nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar gyur cig sa hā/ oṃ badzra rag mo mo mo swā hā/ srin mo byang gi 'brog srin chu srin gdong can gyi nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar gyur cig swā hā/

nad pa 'di la bsrung du gsol bsrung du gsol lo// drang srong chen po rā hu la'i sprul pa 'gyu ba'i gza' bdun gyi snying po 'di lta ste/ oṃ badzra sha sh-i ra dha ra dha ra swā hā/ gza' nyi ma'i nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar gyur cig swā hā/ a badzra rmu rmu baṃ dhi ri dhi ri swā hā/ gza' zla ba'i nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar gyur cig swā hā/ oṃ badzra me me ri dhu ru dha ru swā hā/ gza' mig dmar gyi nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar gyur cig swā hā/ oṃ badzra mu mu baṃ dha ra dha ra swā hā/ gza' lhag pa'i nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar gyur cig sa hu/ oṃ shaṃ shaṃ shing dha ro dha ro swā hā/ gza' phur bu'i nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar gyur cig swā hā/ oṃ laṃ laṃ kha dha kha dha swā hā/ gza' pa wa sangs kyi nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar gyur cig swā hā/ oṃ sa sa dha sa dha sa swā hā/ gza' spen pa'i nad thams cad rab tu zhi ba ra gyur cig swā hā/ nad pa 'di la bsrung du gsol bsrung du gsol lo// nyi zla gza'i pho nya rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi gzungs ni 'di lta ste/ oṃ badzra du sha na ti na ma gha na ma ka ra lhang lhang tser tser ba gti ba ni swā hā/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar gyur cig swā hā/ drang srong chen po rā hu la'i sprul pa 'gyu ba'i gza' bdun gyi gzungs ni 'di lta ste/ oṃ srin srin mu sha ma nya na she ma shu ka ha ri ku ri mu risu ri phu ri dha ri mu swā hā/ kong btsun mo dang*/ dgra lha mo dang*/ ma mo la sogs te sde brgyad kyi nad thams cad zhi bar gyur cig swā hā/ nad pa 'di la bsrung du gsol bsrung du gsol lo// drang srong gza'i bran dang g.yog tu gyur pa'i gegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu'i nad thams cad zhi bar gyur cig swā hā/ oṃ badzra shaṃ ha tṛ suṃ ru tra ma kha tra ye swā hā/ gegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu'i gnod pa thams cad zhi bar gyur cig swā hā/

nad pa 'di la bsrung du gsol bsrung du gsol lo// gza'i gdon thams cad mi gtsang ba las gyur pas/ khrus kyi gzungs 'di lta ste/ oṃ tsanḍa ma hā yakṣa badzra tsanḍa kro dha ya/ hu lu hu lu/ tiṣṭha tiṣṭha/ bhan dha bhan dha/ ha na ha na/ a mri te hūṃ phaṭa/ mi gtsang ba thams cad dag par gyur cig /mi gtsang ba thams cad zhi bar gyur cig /gza' dang*/ rgyu skar gyi nad dang*/ byad stems thams cad rab tu zhi bar gyur cig swā hā/ nad pa 'di la bsrung du gsol lo/ bsrung bar mdzad du gsol lo// gza' mi rgyu bar gyur cig /gza' mi ldog par gyur cig /gza' mi 'bab par gyur cig /sde brgyad kyi chad pa las thar bar gyur cig /gza' gnas su bzhugs par gyur cig /gza'i nad thams cad las grol bar gyur cig /gzungs sngags 'di'i mthus/ 'gro ba mi'i lus drang srong gza'i byad ka grol bar gyur cig /de skad ces bka' bstsal pa dang*/ yab yum ming sring dang*/ rgyu ba'i gza' bdun dang*/ rgyu skar nyi shu brgyad dang*/ gegs dang*/ sde brgyad la sogs pas rang rang gi snying po phul bas/ dpal phyag na rdo rje thugs dgyes te/ dam la btags nas/ rang rang gi gnas su bde ba la bkod do// mngon par bstod do// gza'i nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i gzungs kyi mdo drang srong yab kyi gzungs rdzogs so/// /shu bha mastu sarba dzā ga twaṃ/// /
